title: Black Cobras (2nd)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.230 Numbered Discourses 5.230
  • 23. Dīghacārikavagga 23. Long Wandering

Dutiyakaṇhasappasutta Black Cobras (2nd)

“Pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of a black cobra. Katame pañca? What five? Kodhano, upanāhī, ghoraviso, dujjivho, mittadubbhī. It’s irritable, acrimonious, venomous, fork-tongued, and treacherous. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. These are the five dangers of a black cobra.

Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime ādīnavā mātugāme. In the same way there are these five drawbacks of a lady. Katame pañca? What five? Kodhano, upanāhī, ghoraviso, dujjivho, mittadubbhī. She’s irritable, acrimonious, venomous, fork-tongued, and treacherous. Tatridaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā—This is a lady’s venom: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo. usually she’s very lustful. Tatridaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā—This is a lady’s forked tongue: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco. usually she backbites. Tatridaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa mittadubbhitā—This is a lady’s treachery: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo aticārinī. usually she’s an adulteress. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā mātugāme”ti. These are the five drawbacks of a lady.”

Dasamaṁ.

Dīghacārikavaggo tatiyo.

Tassuddānaṁ

Dve dīghacārikā vuttā, atinivāsamaccharī; Dve ca kulūpakā bhogā, bhattaṁ sappāpare duveti.
